hero.title: Digitise your business and save time for what matters
hero.subtitle: We build custom websites, automate your processes with AI, and keep your equipment running. All with a single technology partner.

services.title: Everything your business needs to operate digitally
services.lead: Three areas, one goal: technology working for you, not the other way around.
services.web_text: Corporate and custom websites that load fast, rank on Google, and turn visitors into customers. Design tailored to your brand and every device.
services.auto_text: We connect your tools and automate repetitive tasks using n8n-style workflows and artificial intelligence: invoices, emails, CRM, reports… on autopilot.
services.maint_text: Preventive maintenance and technical support for your business computers: fewer breakdowns, more security, and zero surprises.

about.title: Your tech department, without the overhead
about.p1: DevDyD was created to bring technology closer to businesses that don't have (and don't need) their own IT department. We speak your language — no jargon — and we're with you from the first idea through day-to-day support.
about.p2: What sets us apart is simple: closeness — direct contact with whoever is building your project —, ongoing technical support whenever you need it, and 100% custom solutions, because every business works differently.

why.title: Reasons to work with DevDyD
why.speed_text: Clear deadlines from day one and phased deliveries so you see progress from the first week.
why.support_text: We don't disappear after delivery: maintenance, improvements, and fast response whenever an issue arises.
why.price_text: Budgets tailored to the reality of small and medium-sized businesses, with no hidden costs.
why.exp_text: Years building websites, automating processes, and maintaining infrastructure for real businesses.
